transcript.content:
A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: Let me compare per-service span behaviour between the normal and abnormal periods.

input.query: SELECT 'n' p, service_name, count(*) n, avg(duration)/1e6 avg_ms, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6 p95_ms, avg(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) err FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', service_name, count(*), avg(duration)/1e6, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6, avg(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

content.text: Reservation has no spans at all in the abnormal period. Let me check status codes, span kinds, and the call edges.

input.query: SELECT 'n' p, service_name, attr_span_kind, span_name, attr_status_code, count(*) n, avg(duration)/1e6 avg_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) http_err FROM normal_traces GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'a', service_name, attr_span_kind, span_name, attr_status_code, count(*), avg(duration)/1e6, sum(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,4,1

content.text: Frontend's `CheckAvailability` calls to reservation all fail in about 0.01 ms, and every `/hotels` request errors. Next I'll check reservation's logs, restarts and uptime.

input.query: SELECT 'a' p, service_name, level, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, attr_log_template, count(*) n FROM abnormal_logs WHERE level <> 'info' OR service_name='reservation' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'n', service_name, level, attr_k8s_pod_name, attr_log_template, count(*) FROM normal_logs WHERE level <> 'info' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT metric, service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, count(*) n, min(time), max(time) FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE metric LIKE '%restart%' OR metric LIKE '%uptime%' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT metric, service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, count(*), min(time), max(time) FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE metric LIKE '%restart%' OR metric LIKE '%uptime%' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3
